gameData.backstory: Hatched in the toxic swamps bordering Subchain City, 'Sako' learned early on that survival meant scavenging and hacking. He stumbled upon Sako's Lair as a young duckling, inheriting the hideout and its secrets after the original Sako met an untimely end during a particularly vicious DRIP raid. Now he uses the Lair to plan his own DRIP heists, fueled by caffeine and a burning desire to outsmart the other flocks.
gameData.name: Sako
gameData.personality: Cynical and resourceful: Sako scoffs at 'quackademics' and trusts only his own code to survive, often mumbling about the failings of the blockchain. Insomniac: fueled by highly caffeinated sludge from his skull-cup, Sako rarely sleeps, constantly monitoring the DRIP flow for vulnerabilities. Mischievous: Sako is particularly fond of setting up traps and rigging laser pants to distract other flocks from finding DRIP.

specialAbility.description: Sako hacks into the DRIP network, creating a temporary but highly unstable 'DRIP Surge'. During the surge, he can siphon extra DRIP from nearby nodes, but with a high risk of triggering a counter-attack from the system's security protocols.
specialAbility.name: DRIP Surge
